recognize_zh: 抹片中散在數個大型母細胞，核圓形或腎形略有凹痕、染色質細緻，細胞質中等量、灰藍色且無顆粒；帶凹痕核的前單核球與單核母細胞混合出現，符合單核球系白血病復發。
features: Several large blasts with round to reniform, slightly indented nuclei
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm, some cells with eccentric nuclei
Admixture of monoblast-like and promonocyte-like forms with nuclear indentation
No Auer rods seen; background red cells with occasional crenated forms and a platelet clump
describe_en: Marrow smear shows scattered large blasts with round to reniform, focally indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, faint nucleoli, and moderate amounts of grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Forms with nuclear indentation resembling promonocytes are admixed with rounder monoblast-like cells. Auer rods are not seen, and background red cells show occasional crenation with a small platelet clump. In a patient with known acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia, these findings are consistent with relapse; confirmation with nonspecific esterase and flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: AMML contains ≥20% granulocytic lineage cells, including MPO-positive myeloblasts and maturing granulocytes, in addition to monocytic cells.
CMML has mostly mature monocytes with condensed chromatin and blasts plus promonocytes below 20%.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and lack nuclear folding and nonspecific esterase activity.
